summary: Provides various summary reports of fee demands, concessions, payable amounts, received amounts, and pending balances, categorized by head, course, or category.
steps: The report will show demand, concession, payable, received, and balance pending for each fee head.
To view course-wise summary, select "Course wise" option and choose specific courses (e.g., Class one, Class five).
To view category-wise summary, select "Category wise" option (e.g., General admission category).
To view group-wise summary (used in colleges if fee head groups are defined), select "Group wise" option.
To view a combined summary of multiple fee heads, select "Combined Head wise" option.
business_rules: "Group wise" summary is typically used in colleges where fee head groups are defined.
important_notes: These reports provide a high-level overview of the financial status of fees.
questions: How can I get a summary of fee demands, collections, and outstanding balances?
Can I view fee summaries by fee head, course, or admission category?
What is the purpose of the fee summary report?
